title: Dagupan cathedral’s flood control system eyed as model nationwide

blocks.text: DAGUPAN CITY – Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon said he intends to replicate the solution devised by the St. John Cathedral in this Pangasinan city to drain floodwater into a cistern under its parking lot to keep the church and its courtyard dry on rainy days. Dizon and Pangasinan Fourth District Representative Gina de Venecia
